body.name: \(\Phi_{1,n}\) and \(\Phi_{2,n}\)
body.construction: For \(j\in\{1,2\}\), start from \(\widetilde\Phi_{j,n}=\{t\mapsto\sum_{\ell=1}^{M_n}w_{j\ell}e^{itu_{j\ell}}:w_{j\ell}\ge0,\sum_{\ell}w_{j\ell}=1,-H_n\le u_{j1}\le\cdots\le u_{jM_n}\le H_n,\sum_{\ell}w_{j\ell}|u_{j\ell}|^{q_e}\le M_e,\inf_{|t|\le\nu_0}|\sum_{\ell}w_{j\ell}e^{itu_{j\ell}}|\ge c_0/2\}\). Set \(\Phi_{1,n}=\widetilde\Phi_{1,n}\) and \(\Phi_{2,n}=\{\phi\in\widetilde\Phi_{2,n}:|\sum_{\ell}w_{2\ell}u_{2\ell}|\le2M_eH_n^{1-q_e}\}\). Zero-weight atoms are placed at \(H_n\), and the ordered atom vector is selected lexicographically, which removes representation ambiguity without centering \(U_1\).
